---
name: Bug report
about: Describe a reproducible problem.
---

## Description

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

List the steps or commands, relevant configuration, and a minimal example. Remove credentials and private data from logs.

## Environment

Include the version or commit, operating system, architecture, and relevant configuration mode.

## Diagnostics

Include the error message, relevant logs, and any test that reproduces the failure.
